'''May 2000 Madison tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Madison, WI on 18 May 2000. [[Evan Fitzgerald]] won it. It is known from Evan Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d763">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-19-madison-wi-5-19-00-otsdd763/ madison-wi-5-19-00-otsd], DeckTech (Evan "Lorax" Fitzgerald, 19 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-19-madison-wi-5-19-00-otsdd763/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Madison, WI
* '''Format:''' [[Enhanced Format Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Evan Fitzgerald]]
